atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
atrBaseLen = input(100, "ATR Base Length", 20, 250, 1)
rangeLen = input(10, "Range Length", 2, 60, 1)
rangeBaseLen = input(100, "Range Base Length", 20, 250, 1)
volOfVolLen = input(20, "Vol of Vol Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilThresh = input(0.35, "Coil Floor", 0.05, 0.9, 0.05)
loadedThresh = input(0.70, "Loaded Threshold", 0.1, 0.95, 0.05)
predictLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 2, 60, 1)
predictThresh = input(0.55, "Predictability Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.05)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Range Mult", 1.0, 4.0, 0.1)
releaseAtrMult = input(1.1, "Release ATR Mult", 1.0, 2.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

a = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
aBase = atr(high, low, close, atrBaseLen)
aSafe = aBase + 0.000001
atrCompRaw = 1 - a / aSafe
atrCompLow = max(atrCompRaw, 0.0)
atrComp = min(atrCompLow, 1.0)
rngNow = sma(high - low, rangeLen)
rngBaseRaw = highest(high - low, rangeBaseLen)
rngBase = max(rngBaseRaw, 0.000001)
rangeCoilRaw = 1 - rngNow / rngBase
rangeCoilLow = max(rangeCoilRaw, 0.0)
rangeCoil = min(rangeCoilLow, 1.0)
coilLoad = (atrComp + rangeCoil) / 2
atrChange = a - a[1]
atrChangeSd = stdev(atrChange, volOfVolLen)
volOfVol = atrChangeSd / aSafe
risingVolOfVol = volOfVol > volOfVol[1]
effLen = max(predictLen, 1)
numP = abs(close - close[effLen])
sumAbs = 0.0
for i = 1 to effLen {
    sumAbs = sumAbs + abs(close[i - 1] - close[i])
}
denP = max(sumAbs, 0.000001)
predictability = min(numP / denP, 1.0)
isPredictable = predictability > predictThresh
rangeNowLag = rngNow[1]
rangeExpand = (high - low) > releaseMult * rangeNowLag
atrExpand = a > releaseAtrMult * a[1]
releaseExpansion = rangeExpand and atrExpand
armed = coilLoad > loadedThresh and risingVolOfVol
coilOk = coilLoad >= coilThresh
buySig = armed and coilOk and releaseExpansion and close > open and close > high[1]
sellSig = armed and coilOk and releaseExpansion and close < open and close < low[1]
buyPred = buySig and isPredictable
buyUnpred = buySig and not isPredictable
sellPred = sellSig and isPredictable
sellUnpred = sellSig and not isPredictable
loadedLvl = loadedThresh
predictLvl = predictThresh
coilRidge = coilLoad * (0.35 + 0.65 * predictability)
coneBuy = (0.6 + coilLoad * 1.2) * markerSize
coneSell = (0.6 + coilLoad * 1.2) * markerSize

if buyPred { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Predictable Release Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if buyUnpred { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Unpredictable Release Buy", "triangleup", "#6f8f88") }
if sellPred { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Predictable Release Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if sellUnpred { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Unpredictable Release Sell", "triangledown", "#8f6f7a") }
if buyPred { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Pred Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", coneBuy, 0, "separate") }
if buyUnpred { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Unpred Buy", "coneup", "#6f8f88", coneBuy, 0, "separate") }
if sellPred { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Pred Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", coneSell, 0, "separate") }
if sellUnpred { plotshape_3d(bar_index, coilLoad, "Unpred Sell", "conedown", "#8f6f7a", coneSell, 0, "separate") }

c1 = plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
c2 = plot(loadedLvl, "Loaded", "#ffd43b", 1, "separate")
fill(c1, c2, "#22aaff")
plot(predictability, "Predictability", "#b48cff", 2, "separate")
plot(predictLvl, "Predictable Line", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot3d(coilLoad, "Coil Load Height", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(coilRidge, "Predictable Ridge", "trail", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)

sessLen = input(20, "SessionLength", 10, 500, 1)
htfLook = input(10, "StructuralLookback1H", 5, 100, 1)
minDisp = input(0.2, "MinStructureDisplacement", 0.05, 2.0, 0.05)
confThresh = input(60, "ConfidenceThreshold", 0, 100, 1)
hardStopTicks = input(2, "HardStopOffset", 1, 50, 1)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessHighPrev = sessHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = sessLow[1]

htfClose = security("1h", close)
htfHigh = security("1h", high)
htfLow = security("1h", low)
htfClosePrev = htfClose[1]

swingHigh1H = highest(htfHigh, htfLook)
swingLow1H = lowest(htfLow, htfLook)
priorSwingHigh = swingHigh1H[1]
priorSwingLow = swingLow1H[1]

dispBull = priorSwingHigh > 0 ? (htfClose - priorSwingHigh) / priorSwingHigh * 100 : 0
dispBear = priorSwingLow > 0 ? (priorSwingLow - htfClose) / priorSwingLow * 100 : 0

bullBreak = htfClose > priorSwingHigh and dispBull > minDisp
bearBreak = htfClose < priorSwingLow and dispBear > minDisp

bullDistBonus = dispBull > minDisp * 2 ? 30 : 15
bearDistBonus = dispBear > minDisp * 2 ? 30 : 15

bullNoOverlap = htfLow > priorSwingHigh and htfLow[1] > priorSwingHigh and htfLow[2] > priorSwingHigh
bearNoOverlap = htfHigh < priorSwingLow and htfHigh[1] < priorSwingLow and htfHigh[2] < priorSwingLow

bullQuality = bullBreak ? 40 + bullDistBonus + (bullNoOverlap ? 30 : 0) : 0
bearQuality = bearBreak ? 40 + bearDistBonus + (bearNoOverlap ? 30 : 0) : 0

isBull = bullBreak
isBear = bearBreak and not bullBreak
quality = isBull ? bullQuality : isBear ? bearQuality : 0
confNorm = quality / 100

tickEst = close * 0.0001
hardStopOff = hardStopTicks * tickEst
hardStopLong = sessLow - hardStopOff
hardStopShort = sessHigh + hardStopOff

breakHigh = close > sessHighPrev
breakLow = close < sessLowPrev
confOk = quality >= confThresh

buySig = breakHigh and isBull and confOk
sellSig = breakLow and isBear and confOk

exitLongLevel = close < sessLowPrev
exitLongStop = low <= hardStopLong
exitShortLevel = close > sessHighPrev
exitShortStop = high >= hardStopShort

exitLong = exitLongLevel or exitLongStop or sellSig
exitShort = exitShortLevel or exitShortStop or buySig

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confNorm)
    model.stopLoss(hardStopOff, "abs")
    model.shortExit("siege")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confNorm)
    model.stopLoss(hardStopOff, "abs")
    model.longExit("siege")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if exitLong {
    model.longExit("siege")
}
if exitShort {
    model.shortExit("siege")
}
stateTxt = isBull ? "1H: BULL" : isBear ? "1H: BEAR" : "1H: NEUTRAL"
stateCol = isBull ? "#22cc88" : isBear ? "#ff4477" : "#888888"
text.new(bar_index, high, stateTxt, stateCol, 12, "htfState")
plot(sessHigh, "SessionHigh", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "SessionLow", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(hardStopLong, "HardStopLong", "#ff8800", 1, "stepline")
plot(hardStopShort, "HardStopShort", "#ff8800", 1, "stepline")
